snippet.title: Matryoshka - Trailer
snippet.description:
Matryoshka is a spooky puzzle game, that will launch on October 16th 2026. 

Wishlist on Steam! : https://store.steampowered.com/app/5058440/Matryoshka/ 


About Matryoshka:
Among ordinary Matryoshka dolls, cursed ones have been secretly mixed in—vessels containing something that feeds on people.

Your job is to carefully inspect each doll, one layer at a time. If you discover a cursed Matryoshka, you must immediately burn it in the sacred furnace to seal the curse. But if you fail to notice one…
